issues.legal_issue: A tenant’s voluntary delivery of possession does not validate a surrender that fails the statutory formalities or permit a landlord to take possession without an order of the competent authority.
material_facts: The tenants held the land as tenants.
They delivered possession to the landlord, who took possession without an order of the Tahsildar.
The surrender was neither in writing nor verified before the Tahsildar in the prescribed manner.
After the landlord later leased the land to another person, the tenants applied for restoration of possession.
issues.conclusion: The surrender was ineffective and the landlord’s possession was unlawful; the tenants could apply for restoration under section 36(1).
issues.legal_principle: Section 20 of the Bombay Tenancy and Agricultural Lands (Vidarbha Region) Act, 1958 requires a surrender to be in writing and verified in the prescribed manner. Section 36(2) prohibits a landlord from obtaining possession of land held by a tenant except under an order of the Tahsildar, and section 36(1) permits a tenant evicted in contravention of that prohibition to apply for possession. Consent or voluntary delivery does not make possession valid without the required formal surrender and order. The Court followed Madho S/o Tatya Sonar v. Maharashtra Revenue Tribunal & Ors. It expressed no opinion on whether verification alone, without an order authorising possession, would prevent a tenant from seeking restoration.

rule.if: tenant_held_land and restoration_application_after_eviction and surrender_not_written and surrender_not_verified and landlord_lacked_possession_order

predicates.tenant_held_land: A person held the land as a tenant.
predicates.restoration_application_after_eviction: A tenant applied for restoration after being dispossessed from the land.
predicates.surrender_not_written: The tenant’s surrender of the tenancy was not made in writing.
predicates.surrender_not_verified: The tenant’s surrender was not verified by the competent authority in the prescribed manner.
predicates.landlord_lacked_possession_order: The landlord obtained possession without an order from the competent authority.

issues.definition: When a tenant applies for restoration after eviction, and the surrender lacked the required writing and verification while the landlord also lacked an order authorising possession, the landlord’s possession is unlawful and the tenant may apply for restoration.
